_comment: Paired recipe-knob env for the otr_8gb_wan preset (video-tiers). Recipe knobs the director/render widgets do NOT own (steps / decode-tiling / the landscape canvas); the profile remains the source of truth. OTR_WAN_TI2V_MAX_FRAMES is kept as the boot-time twin of video.max_render_frames (2026-07-24): the director widget is what binds a production leg, and an explicit env pin still outranks it. A launcher CLEARS the prior-tier key set, exports these, then boots + loads workflows/otr_canonical.json + applies the profile in memory (never this preset as the workflow). wan_8gb is flag-free (requires_flag=None; selection does NOT depend on OTR_ENABLE_WAN_TI2V).
